description:
Astronomer empowers data teams to bring mission-critical software, analytics, and AI to life and is the company behind Astro, the industry-leading unified DataOps platform powered by Apache Airflow®. Astro accelerates building reliable data products that unlock insights, unleash AI value, and power data-driven applications. Trusted by more than 900 of the world’s leading enterprises, including Datadog, American Express, Expedia, Adobe, Autodesk, Together AI, and more, Astronomer lets businesses do more with their data. To learn more, visit www.astronomer.io.

Astronomer is investing in a global ecosystem that helps customers get more value from Astro and helps our partners grow their businesses with us. We’re looking for a Senior Director of Ecosystem Strategy and Programs to build the strategy, solutions, growth, and intelligence capabilities that will scale this business.

The initial focus is establishing these high leverage growth Partner Programs in accordance with a defined and targeted Partner Strategy. This includes setting strategy and business plans, building partner solutions and technical enablement, creating partner-led and product-led growth programs, and developing the intelligence, tools, automation, and AI that improve decisions and execution. You’ll stay close to partners and opportunities as you build repeatable systems for onboarding, joint go-to-market, customer adoption, and expansion.

This role reports to the Vice President of Global Partner Ecosystem and is suited to a strategic, hands-on leader who can move between executive alignment, program design, and practical execution.

Location: Remote-based / Hybrid in NYC or San Francisco Bay Area

As Senior Director, Ecosystem Strategy and Programs, you’ll get to:

  • Set the ecosystem strategy and program architecture: Define partner segments, priorities, engagement models, program principles, and the partner journey from recruitment and onboarding through activation, growth, and renewal.

  • Lead ecosystem and GTM business planning: Identify the partners, markets, solutions, and programs with the greatest growth potential, translate priorities into plans, and drive cross-functional execution.

  • Build programs around shared customer outcomes: Create clear participation paths, value propositions, requirements, benefits, and success measures for technology, cloud, services, and strategic partners.

  • Make partner economics work: Develop scalable approaches to partner incentives, co-investment, marketplace motions, and joint business planning in partnership with Finance and Sales leadership.

  • Turn partnerships into pipeline and adoption: Establish repeatable co-sell, referral, solution development, and customer expansion motions with clear ownership, qualification, handoffs, and feedback loops.

  • Build partner solutions capabilities: Lead partner solution architecture, technical onboarding and enablement, integrations, and joint solution development. Help partners position, integrate, and deliver Astronomer, and connect partner-led opportunities with the right technical resources.

  • Equip partners to reach the market: Work with Marketing and Sales to develop partner messaging, campaigns, events, solution briefs, case studies, and field enablement that generate demand and improve deal execution.

  • Accelerate ecosystem and product-led growth: Develop programs across acquisition, activation, lifecycle engagement, adoption, consumption growth, retention, and expansion in partnership with Product, Sales, and Customer Success.

  • Create a consistent partner experience: Simplify program requirements, onboarding, enablement, partner communications, and internal processes so partners can focus on customers and growth.

  • Build the operating system for the ecosystem: Own program governance, planning cadences, partner business reviews, performance reporting, and cross-functional accountability.

  • Develop ecosystem intelligence and AI capabilities: Build business intelligence, ecosystem analytics, customer insights, enabling tools, and automation. Use data and AI to surface growth opportunities, improve decision quality, and increase GTM productivity.

  • Expand shared GTM support as the ecosystem scales: Apply proven strategy, growth, and intelligence capabilities to cross-functional GTM priorities, including customer growth and retention initiatives and AI-enabled ways of working.

  • Measure business outcomes: Track partner-sourced and ecosystem-influenced pipeline and revenue, partner onboarding and productivity, acquisition and activation, customer adoption, consumption, retention and expansion, and the impact of shared GTM programs.

  • Represent Astronomer with partners and the industry: Build trusted executive relationships and communicate a compelling vision for how partners can grow alongside Astronomer.

What success looks like

  • A scalable ecosystem strategy with the programs, partner solutions, team capabilities, and infrastructure needed to support partners in delivering net new logos, customer expansion, and capabilities in emergent Airflow use cases..

  • Faster partner onboarding, stronger technical capabilities, and higher partner productivity.

  • Increased partner-sourced and ecosystem-influenced pipeline and revenue.

  • More effective ecosystem and product-led acquisition, activation, and conversion.

  • Improved customer adoption, consumption, retention, and expansion.

  • Better GTM decisions and execution through actionable intelligence, scalable operations, and AI-enabled productivity.

A shared GTM growth capability that improves strategic execution and commercial effectiveness across Astronomer.

What we’re looking for:

  • 10+ years of experience in partner ecosystems, alliances, channels, partner programs, or related go-to-market leadership roles, including significant experience in enterprise software, cloud, data, or developer platforms.

  • 5+ years leading teams or complex cross-functional programs, with a record of setting strategy and delivering measurable results.

  • Experience designing or scaling a partner program, including partner segmentation, onboarding, enablement, benefits, incentives, performance standards, and governance.

  • A track record of building partner motions that create measurable business impact, such as sourced or influenced pipeline, revenue, customer adoption, marketplace growth, or successful delivery.

  • Experience translating business strategy into growth programs across acquisition, activation, adoption, retention, and expansion.

  • Experience building or using business intelligence, ecosystem analytics, customer insights, or operating tools to identify opportunities and improve execution.

  • Strong understanding of partner go-to-market models, including co-selling, referrals, joint business planning, solution development, and cloud marketplace programs.

  • Experience collaborating across Sales, Product, Engineering, Marketing, Customer Success, Finance, and Operations to deliver programs with shared accountability.

  • A data-driven approach to program design and investment. You can define useful metrics, interpret performance, and adjust resources based on results.

  • Practical experience applying automation or AI to improve GTM decisions, workflows, or team productivity.

  • Executive presence and communication skills, with the ability to build alignment across senior internal leaders and external partner executives.

  • Strategic thinking paired with a bias toward action. You can set direction, make sound tradeoffs, and stay close to execution as programs take shape.

  • Comfort with ambiguity and pace in a high-growth company, and a collaborative, low-ego style that fits a no-handoffs culture.

Bonus points if you have:

  • Experience in an open-source, data, analytics, AI, cloud infrastructure, or developer-tools ecosystem.

  • Familiarity with Apache Airflow, data orchestration, or the modern data stack.

  • Experience building partner programs at a SaaS company moving from early ecosystem development to global scale.

  • Experience with cloud partner programs, marketplace listings and private offers, co-sell systems, partner relationship management tools, or channel incentive operations.

  • Experience building partner communities, certification or accreditation programs, solution validation frameworks, or partner-delivered services practices.

At Astronomer, we value diversity. We are an equal opportunity employer: we do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status.
